evaluation.results_summary: Qwen2 outperforms most prior open-weight models, including Qwen1.5, and is competitive with proprietary models across language understanding, generation, multilingual ability, coding, mathematics, and reasoning.
evaluation.safety_evals: The developer reports safety measures including multilingual safety assessments and red teaming exercises.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: text-output dense decoder-only model with reported results emphasizing broad capabilities but no reported factuality/grounding evaluation in the card summary

specifications.model_size: 14.2 GiB of safetensors weights (15,231,271,856 bytes) in BF16
